messages:
Maria: quick one — product wants a 'silent degeneration' rollout mode. idea: when errors/latency spike, quietly route a percentage to a cheaper/safer model so users don't see a hard error. we need UX for operators: how do we make this auditable and debuggable without spamming alerts?
Sam: agree conceptually. main concerns: quota/billing attribution and observability. if we route 30% to fallback, do we bill original model or fallback? also want per-request headers so we can slice metrics.
Josh: technically we can add x-fallback-reason and x-fallback-variant headers + trace tags. console could surface a per-route breakdown (orig vs fallback) and allow filtering by reason. that keeps operators from digging through raw logs.
Tia: product note — operators need two controls: 1) degeneration level (0-100%) and 2) severity thresholds (soft/hard). also an obvious 'reveal' toggle so SREs can force visible degradation for debugging. most users won't want to see UI flicker, but we need a way to inspect.
Maria: legal asked for decision trace retention for 90 days. that's expensive if we store full payloads. can we do sampled full traces + indexed breadcrumbs for all decisions?
Sam: propose schema: record compact breadcrumb for every decision (timestamp, route_from, route_to, reason, latency_ms) and store full request/response only at sample_rate. that gives auditability without full retention cost.
Josh: policy example (prototype):
```json
{
  "mode": "silent_degen",
  "trigger": "p95_latency>750",
  "action": { "route": "model-compact:v2", "percent": 30, "hysteresis_ms": 60000 },
  "audit": { "breadcrumb_sample_rate": 1.0, "full_sample_rate": 0.05, "breadcrumb_fields": ["route_from","route_to","reason","latency_ms"] }
}
```
Tia: UI ideas: in the rollout page show a compact timeline that indicates when "silent_degen" fired, a heatmap of triggers (errors/latency), and an on-demand 'forensics' panel showing sampled full traces. export CSV for compliance. include a small cost delta estimate widget.
Sam: edge-case: fallback could silently reduce quality. we should tie an automated rollback rule based on an eval prompt-set. e.g., if quality score delta > X over Y minutes, auto-roll back and create an alert. also need to cap cost drift.
Maria: operator overrides: allow 'force_visible=true' via API and console button. default silent mode should still set a visible incident if fallback rate or error threshold crosses emergency threshold.
Josh: implementational note: routing service must emit both metrics and breadcrumb events atomically to avoid mismatch when sampling. also add a trace id header so forensic joins are easy.
ops-bot: @channel reminder: we'll prototype silent_degen in staging next week (mon) 10:00 PT. PR for policy editor extension pending. :spiral_calendar: :construction:
Tia: can someone put together mockups for the rollout page panel? short list of fields we need: trigger, percent, hysteresis, sample rates, cost delta, auto-rollback criteria.
Sam: I'll sketch quick mock and attach to the PR. +1 on breadcrumb sampling approach.
Maria: thanks team — main action items: Sam mock + telemetry contract, Josh routing/tracing changes, Tia UI mockups, and we'll sync monday after prototype. :thumbsup:
